description: The published Wowbagger JSON Schemas. Each $id is a stable identifier, not a fetch URL: resolve a schema from the installed package as wowbagger/schemas/<file>. `domain` names the response domain the schema belongs to and `version` the version of that domain, which is not the distribution version.

schemas.summary: The bare ready success result.
The bare validate result, also emitted by ready on an invalid ledger.
Definitions reused by the schemas below. Not a validation target on its own.
The capabilities envelope, including every advertised semantic limit.
Every core-domain --json response: the four exact root shapes, with no namespace member.
The default lossless inspect read.
The opt-in bounded workbench affordance projection, projection version 1.
Every documented list refusal.
The strict list request, query version 1.
A bounded, paginated list page.
Report publication and refusal responses, including a named view.
Every documented transition refusal, with its mutation state.
The strict transition request.
A committed transition.
Legacy-write fence refusals in the ledger-mutation namespace.
The read-only duplicate-number repair proposal result.
The strict number-repair request, covering the complete duplicate set.
Every ledger-repair response: the proposal and apply envelopes at repair version 1.
The report configuration file at report_version 1.
The report configuration file at report_version 2, which names views.
